summary.intent: Deploy the cipher-box TEE worker to Phala Cloud as part of the Phase 35 Phala Testnet TEE Migration, starting from Task 2 of plan 35-06.
summary.outcome: Docker image was successfully built for linux/amd64, pushed to GHCR, and the CVM deployed to Phala Cloud — health endpoint confirmed healthy with mode 'cvm' and epoch 1. Session was paused before completing Tasks 3-5 (epoch persistence, republish cycle, latency baselines).

repo: The Dockerfile for tee-worker was missing @cipherbox/api-client as a build dependency — it's required by @cipherbox/sdk-core for DTS generation.
The docker-compose.phala.yml uses envsubst-style variable substitution with ':-' default syntax, which standard envsubst does not handle — requires manual override.
Phala CVMs run on x86_64; building on macOS (ARM) produces incompatible images that crash with 'exec format error'. Must use --platform linux/amd64.
Phala CVMs aggressively cache Docker images by tag — pushing a new tag (v35-amd64) was required to force a fresh pull after fixing the architecture.

code.finding: Added COPY for packages/api-client and included it in the turbo build pipeline to fix missing @cipherbox/api-client dependency during sdk-core DTS build.

workflow: The Phala CLI 'phala deploy' requires a minimum $1.00 account balance even for free-tier CVMs — the free $20 credit requires a payment method to be added first.
docker login ghcr.io from a non-TTY session requires piping the token via --password-stdin rather than interactive prompt.
GitHub PATs require write:packages scope to push to GHCR.
When redeploying a Phala CVM, use 'phala cvms update --cvm-id' rather than a fresh deploy to update an existing instance.

friction: Docker build failed on first attempt due to missing @cipherbox/api-client dependency not copied into Dockerfile.
GHCR login failed interactively from non-TTY; required --password-stdin workaround.
Phala deploy blocked by $0 account balance — required credit card addition and manual credit allocation before proceeding.
CVM cached the ARM image even after pushing corrected amd64 image under the same 'latest' tag — required a new tag to force fresh pull.
envsubst did not handle ':-' default syntax in docker-compose.phala.yml, requiring manual sed fixup.
Initial Docker image built for ARM (macOS host) instead of linux/amd64, causing exec format error on Phala CVM.
open_items: Task 3: Verify epoch persistence across CVM restarts — epoch 1 public key not yet captured.
Task 4: Verify end-to-end IPNS republish cycle.
